# Lexington MRF diversion gate — producing, constrained

One previously uncatalogued resource is activated: `lexington-mrf-diversion-gate`
is `LIVE / PRODUCING / CONSTRAINED`.

The product itself was already complete and unique. [PR #6675](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/commons/pull/6675)
merged nine exact paths at `21e181d292c99c4f7d1ceba8d0250f050c17d3cd`; this activation does not rewrite
them. Its concrete consumer is Lexington Recycle Center / Julie Hatter and
similarly situated materials-recovery operators needing deterministic per-load
downtime and capacity receipts.

## Measurable production receipt

The public, no-login road consumes a synthetic 50-row fixture and produces:

- 10 duplicate load tickets collapsed;
- 8 stale shutdown notices ignored;
- 10 `LANDFILL_CITY`, 10 `HOLD_HAULER`, 15 `ACCEPT`, and
  5 `HOLD_CAPACITY` receipts;
- accepted occupancy 90t against a 100t cap;
- identical replay SHA-256
  `774dd5fc59cd297a680a870baf788ffc2e2ec1c3fd487175e16c7fd9808f7276`;
- 8/8 focused tests, CLI `ok=true`, open-door guard PASS, and browser
  Run + Replay PASS in the landed product receipt.

This is a real producing evidence road, but its condition is `CONSTRAINED`:
the fixture is synthetic and no buyer acceptance or deployment exists.

## Collision and authority boundary

Activation base: `3271de34a4fdcc9c35e5a759de8b83e346e422f1`.

The only open PR at claim time was #6206, whose cross-harness discovery paths
overlap neither the nine Lexington product paths nor the three activation paths.
No prior #commons claim owned this ledger activation.

Authority is public read and local synthetic replay only. The gate emits
operating-state receipts; it does not control equipment, make autonomous safety
decisions, send alerts, contact the named buyer, submit a bid, set terms, take
payment, or deploy production infrastructure. The separate lead remains
untouched and the no-resend boundary remains in force.

The canonical projection advances from 64 resources / 32 producing to
65 resources / 33 producing. Connected aggregate at observation is 11
automations (4 enabled, 7 paused) and 403 callable tools, including 388
connected-app tools. Disabled automations are excluded from active capacity.

Evidence expires on the next product, buyer, contract, or deployment-state
change. No Grok request or token spend, outreach, equipment action, deployment,
payment, revenue, cash, Cursor use, Claude verification, or Titan mutation
occurred.
